(Japanese: '''ワンダーボヤージュ''' ''Wonder Voyage'') is the eighth arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that will begin airing on May 22, 2026 in Japan. It follows the ''[[Rising Again]]'' arc. The key visual features [[Liko]], [[Roy]], [[Dot]], and [[Ult]], alongside a new companion with a {{p|Ditto}} named [[Navi]]. The visual also includes illustrations reminiscent of {{g|GO}}, {{pkmn|UNITE}}, {{pkmn|Sleep}}, and {{pkmn|Pokopia}}, as well as [[Legendary Pokémon]] from {{g|Scarlet and Violet}} that have yet to make physical appearances in the series. It was first announced on April 17, 2026.

The arc's opening theme is [[Connect the World]] performed by [[Liko]] (CV: [[Minori Suzuki]]) & [[Roy]] (CV: [[Yuka Terasaki]])., and the ending theme is [[CUTIE SPHERE]] performed by Cutie Street.
